Maharashtra ministers Hassan Mushrif & Prakash Abitkar alerted hospitals about the treatable HMPV (Human metapneumovirus) virus after cases in Karnataka, TN & Gujarat. Two suspected cases in Nagpur are under test. SOPs, isolation wards, and resources are being prepared.
